items.stem: A department has 30% annual turnover concentrated in the first 90 days of employment. Which intervention most directly targets that pattern?

options.text: A structured onboarding and 30/60/90-day check-in programme
options.rationale: Correct: early-tenure turnover is most directly reduced by structured onboarding and early check-ins.
A yearly survey is too infrequent to affect first-90-day attrition.

options.text: A market pay study for senior roles
options.rationale: Senior-role pay does not address new-hire early departures.
Rating scales act on existing staff, not the onboarding window.

items.explanation: Early-tenure turnover is most directly reduced by structured onboarding and early check-ins.

items.stem: Which US law most directly governs advance-notice obligations for certain large layoffs?

options.rationale: Correct: the WARN Act sets advance-notice duties for qualifying mass layoffs and plant closings.
The FLSA covers wages and hours, not layoff notice.
The ADA addresses disability accommodation, not layoff notice.
ERISA governs benefit plans, not layoff notice.

items.explanation: The WARN Act sets advance-notice duties for qualifying mass layoffs.

items.stem: An HR business partner wants to strengthen the Ethical Practice competency on their team. Select TWO actions that most directly support that competency.

options.text: Establish a confidential channel for reporting misconduct
options.rationale: Correct: a safe reporting channel is a core ethical-practice control.

options.text: Publish and model a clear conflict-of-interest policy
options.rationale: Correct: transparent conflict-of-interest handling is central to ethical practice.

options.text: Increase the annual training budget for technical HRIS skills
options.rationale: HRIS training builds technology skills, not the ethical-practice competency.
Faster hiring is an efficiency goal unrelated to ethical practice.

options.text: Add more questions to the engagement survey
options.rationale: Survey length does not build ethical practice.

items.explanation: A confidential reporting channel and a modelled conflict-of-interest policy both directly support ethical practice.
